 ☐ PDF Generation

Where should the per-office PDFs get generated each quarter?

❯ 1. In the publish workflow (Recommended)
     Generate the PDFs as an automated step inside the CI/CD publish pipeline that already runs each quarter, so the
     artifacts are produced consistently every time without anyone needing to remember a manual step. This keeps the
     process auditable in pipeline logs, reproducible across environments, and immune to a person forgetting to run a
     local script before the deadline.
  2. Local RUNBOOK step only
     Keep PDF generation as a documented manual step in the team's local RUNBOOK, run by hand on someone's machine each
     quarter using existing local tooling. This avoids any changes to CI/CD infrastructure and keeps full manual control
     and visibility over each run, but it depends on a person remembering to follow the runbook and having the right
     local environment set up.
  3. Both: CI, plus a one-command local script
     Wire the PDF generation into the CI publish workflow for the automatic quarterly run, and also ship a standalone
     one-command local script that wraps the same logic for ad-hoc regeneration, debugging, or previewing changes before
     they hit CI. This gives redundancy and flexibility but means maintaining two invocation paths that must be kept in
     sync over time.
  4. Type something.
